title: Dark Room
description:
All doors must be unlocked to discover the truth ! 

You open your eyes in an unfamiliar, shadow-drenched room. Your memory yields nothing—no name, no past, and no explanation. Every door is locked, yet the environment feels alive with faint whispers of a forgotten history.

Dark Room is a narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game that plunges you into an unsettling atmospheric mystery. As you explore your dark surroundings, you will uncover handwritten notes left behind by enigmatic strangers. Each letter holds a piece of a tragic puzzle—and every door you unlock brings you one step closer to a truth you may not be prepared to face.

 

Key Features:

• Classic Point & Click Exploration: Immerse yourself in a traditional adventure experience centered on environmental investigation, story progression, and atmosphere.

• Cryptic Storytelling: Piece together a deep, dark narrative through handwritten letters, hidden documents, and environmental clues left by mysterious figures from the past.

• Challenging Puzzles & Hidden Objects: Test your logic by uncovering hidden items, interacting with strange mechanisms, and solving a wide variety of intricate puzzles.

• Evocative Visual Arts & Sound: Experience a uniquely crafted visual style accompanied by an atmospheric soundscape that enhances the feeling of mystery and isolation

Read between the lines, unlock the secrets of the past, and find your way out of the shadows.

Stay connected with Lexip Games for news, updates, and future narrative projects:

• Follow us on X (Twitter): @LexipGames
description_short: Dark Room is an atmospheric point-and-click adventure game. You awaken in a mysterious, locked environment with no memory of who you are. Solve intricate puzzles, inspect hidden objects, and piece together forgotten journal entries to unlock the truth behind your confinement.
